question: If I use ChatGPT to write a book, does OpenAI own the copyright?
expected_answer: No, OpenAI assigns all right, title, and interest in the Output to you.

question: Can I use ChatGPT's answers to train my own AI model and sell it?
expected_answer: No, you cannot use the Output to develop competing models.

question: If I use my company email to sign up, can my boss see my chat history?
expected_answer: Yes, the organization's administrator can control the account and access your Content.

question: If ChatGPT gives me bad medical advice and I get hurt, can I sue OpenAI for millions?
expected_answer: No, liability is limited to $100 or what you paid in the last 12 months, and you shouldn't rely on it for medical advice.

question: Can I join a massive class action lawsuit against OpenAI if they leak my data?
expected_answer: No, you waive the right to class actions and must resolve disputes individually through arbitration.

question: If I haven't logged into my free account for two years, will they delete it?
expected_answer: Yes, they can terminate accounts that have been inactive for over a year if they are not paid.

question: Is there any way I can opt out of the mandatory arbitration rule?
expected_answer: Yes, by filling out an opt-out form within 30 days of creating your account.

question: Will OpenAI use my private prompts to train their future models?
expected_answer: Yes, they may use your Content to train models, unless you specifically opt out.

question: If I find a bug, am I allowed to reverse engineer the app to see how it works?
expected_answer: No, you cannot reverse engineer or decompile the services unless law strictly prohibits this restriction.

question: If I'm living in London, do these exact terms apply to me?
expected_answer: No, users in the UK are governed by a different set of terms.

question: Does ChatGPT keep my credit card information on file forever?
expected_answer: Unanswerable. The Terms of Use do not state how long credit card info is kept.

question: What happens if I try to scrape data from ChatGPT automatically using a python script?
expected_answer: You may not automatically or programmatically extract data or Output.

question: Can I use ChatGPT if I am 15 years old?
expected_answer: Yes, but you must have your parent or legal guardian's permission if you are under 18.

question: If OpenAI increases the price of my ChatGPT Plus subscription, can they just charge my card immediately?
expected_answer: No, they will give at least 30 days' notice, taking effect on the next renewal.

question: Will OpenAI refund me if they randomly decide to shut down the service completely?
expected_answer: Yes, they will give a refund for any prepaid, unused Services.

question: Is OpenAI's API governed by these exact same Terms of Use?
expected_answer: No, Business Terms govern APIs.

question: If I live in North Korea, can I use ChatGPT?
expected_answer: No, services cannot be used in a U.S. embargoed country.

question: If another user generates the exact same poem as me, can I sue them for copying my Output?
expected_answer: No. Output may not be unique and the assignment does not extend to other users' output.

question: What is OpenAI's phone number for customer support?
expected_answer: Unanswerable. A phone number is not provided in the Terms.

question: If I share my account password with my sister so she can use DALL-E, is that allowed?
expected_answer: No, you may not share your account credentials.

question: Can I assign my rights under these Terms to someone else if I sell my business?
expected_answer: No, you may not assign or transfer any rights or obligations under these Terms, and any attempt to do so is void.

question: Before OpenAI can start formal arbitration against me, do they have to try anything else first?
expected_answer: Yes, both parties must first attempt informal dispute resolution; if unresolved within 60 days, either side can initiate arbitration.

question: If OpenAI ignores one violation of the Terms by me, does that mean they give up the right to enforce it against me later?
expected_answer: No, failure to enforce a provision is not a waiver of the right to enforce it later.

question: Can I get emergency injunctive relief from a court, or do I have to wait for arbitration to finish?
expected_answer: Yes, injunctive or other equitable relief to stop unauthorized use, abuse, or IP infringement is excluded from the arbitration requirement.

question: If 30 people with the same lawyer all file similar arbitration claims against OpenAI within 90 days of each other, are the claims handled separately or together?
expected_answer: They are grouped into batches of up to 50 claimants and administered as a single consolidated arbitration.

question: Does OpenAI own the text I type into ChatGPT, or just what it generates back to me?
expected_answer: You retain ownership of your Input; OpenAI assigns you ownership of the Output.

question: If I'm a business customer and someone sues me over how I used ChatGPT, does OpenAI have to defend me?
expected_answer: No, it's the reverse -- as a business, you must indemnify and hold OpenAI harmless from third-party claims arising from your use.

question: Is there a maximum amount of money I could ever win if I sue OpenAI successfully?
expected_answer: Yes, aggregate liability is capped at the greater of what you paid in the prior 12 months or $100.

question: Does OpenAI's Privacy Policy count as a legally binding part of these Terms?
expected_answer: No, the Privacy Policy is an important document to read but does not form part of these Terms.

question: If I'm 12 years old, can I use ChatGPT even with my parents' permission?
expected_answer: No, you must be at least 13 years old (or the minimum age required in your country) regardless of parental consent.

question: How many employees does OpenAI have?
expected_answer: Unanswerable. The Terms of Use do not state OpenAI's employee count.

question: Which specific ChatGPT model version am I entitled to use on the free plan?
expected_answer: Unanswerable. The document does not specify which model versions are included in any particular plan.
